attackers_goals: Remove owners from applications for full control of the application or service principal. Manipulate or delete data stored in the Azure environment.
description: An Azure Owner was removed from an application or service principal. This may indicate malicious activity or unauthorized access to the application or service.
investigative_actions: Check the Azure Activity Log to identify which user removed the Azure Owner.* Check the Azure Role Assignments to identify the current Azure Owners.* Check the Application or Service Principal to identify if any changes have been made.
name: Removal of an Azure Owner from an Application or Service Principal
